This potential acts as a non-linear driver that suppresses individual ego and aligns local agent actions with global collective optimization.

The engine utilizes the devotion metric to weight action-selection policies, ensuring agents prioritize global utility (Alma Mater success) over local reward maximization during high-variance competitive interactions.

primitives.name: Intrinsic Passion Potential

primitives.assumptions: Passion acts as a necessary boundary condition for reaching maximum skill asymptotes.

layer2.telemetry: Voluntary practice hours outside mandatory training blocks.

primitives.name: Collective Utility Subsumption
primitives.verbatim_quote: His own individuality should be entirely sunken in what will redound most to the good of his Alma Mater.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: I: Individual utility vector, C: Collective utility vector, \alpha: Subsumption scalar [0,1]
primitives.assumptions: Optimal team dynamics require \alpha \rightarrow 1, minimizing selfish play.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \alpha \rightarrow 0, resulting in systemic inefficiency and fractured team cohesion.

layer2.mapping: Directly informs GSE's multi-agent reinforcement learning reward shaping functions.
layer2.telemetry: Assist-to-turnover ratio and off-ball movement efficiency metrics.

The provided excerpts establish a rigorous psychological thermodynamics applicable to competitive systems. We begin by defining the Emotional Damping Operator, which mathematically represents the suppression of reactive impulses. In any high-stakes environment, an undamped retaliatory impulse introduces destructive noise into the decision matrix. By enforcing a damping coefficient, the agent transitions from a chaotic, emotionally driven state to a stable, rational equilibrium. This stability is a prerequisite for the second primitive: the Intrinsic Passion Potential. The text explicitly links top-tier success across disparate fields—Wall Street, medicine, politics—to an internal, self-sustaining energy source. Mathematically, this passion acts as a non-vanishing driving force in the agent's differential equation of motion; without it, friction (fatigue, difficulty) inevitably halts progress. Finally, these individual potentials must be integrated into a macroscopic framework via Collective Utility Subsumption. The text argues that individual identity must be subsumed by the collective goal. In our formalism, this is a vector projection operation where the individual utility vector is entirely aligned with the collective utility vector. The duality here lies between the micro-state (individual emotional control and passion) and the macro-state (team victory). Failure modes emerge precisely at the boundaries: if damping fails, the agent becomes erratic; if passion vanishes, the agent stagnates; if subsumption breaks down, the collective system suffers from collinear inefficiencies and selfish play.
